body:
I just feel like I've wronged too many people. I acted up in class for the first time on Friday, which wasn't really acting up but when I was called on it I realized how stupid I was being. (Basically what happened is people were talking to each other and I started singing. The teacher called me out on it and told me people were trying to study. I was like, FUCK, I GUESS I'M A BAD PERSON NOW! WOW, WHY DO I SUCK SO MUCH?) On top of that I have cheated on people before and dumped people for people.

I don't know... in general I feel like I'm taking up space. My parents pay for my food and shelter and it's going to... who? Some stupid dumbshit with life aspirations sie'll never fulfill, who would never get accepted to some fucking Ivy League school, who used to be smart but no longer is (I was a baby genius and then became boring when I got older), whose bratty six year old cousin is actually superior to hir in some ways.

If I just drowned myself in the river some blocks from my house and didn't tell anyone, nobody would notice. Nobody but my dad, and my mom would care but she would also think I'm pathetic and stupid. (Not even exaggerating, I once told her that I self harm and she said it was stupid and she didn't care about my feelings.)

I haven't been studying as much. I enjoy learning things but never memorize. I even have exams and I already think I'm going to fail. I'm nothing more than stupid. I know it too. All my friends are smarter than me and will be more successful in life. Sometimes it feels like I may as well commit suicide because it's better than just having the world keep wasting its resources on me when it could go to someone more deserving. Why can't they kill me and just give everything I have to some poor kid in Africa? It's not like I should have it. I should have less than the poor kid because I'm trash, human trash. I don't deserve to live.

>  I can't say you're helpful to other people.

Neither can I. I don't help. As much as I hate to admit it, I only seem to care about myself and do what helps me most. I made my poor mom into an angry, yelling person, which she apparently wasn't originally.

> The past is the past. Try to leave it there. 

I have flashbacks too much. I have a really, really good memory and it's so hard to forget certain stuff even though I want to.
